units.rightText: He then having received the sop went out straightway: and it was night.

units.leftText: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
units.rightText: When therefore he was gone out, Jesus saith, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him;

units.leftText: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
units.rightText: and God shall glorify him in himself, and straightway shall he glorify him.

units.leftText: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
units.rightText: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say unto you.

units.leftText: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
units.rightText: A new commandment I give unto you, that ye love one another; even as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

units.leftText: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
units.rightText: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

units.leftText: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?”
units.rightText: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow afterwards.

units.leftText: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
units.rightText: Peter saith unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee even now? I will lay down my life for thee.

units.leftText: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
units.rightText: Jesus answereth, Wilt thou lay down thy life for me? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

units.leftText: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
units.rightText: Let not your heart be troubled: believe in God, believe also in me.

units.leftText: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
units.rightText: In my Father’s house are many mansions; if it were not so, I would have told you; for I go to prepare a place for you.

units.leftText: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
units.rightText: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I come again, and will receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

units.leftText: You know where I go, and you know the way.”
units.rightText: And whither I go, ye know the way.

units.leftText: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
units.rightText: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; how know we the way?

units.leftText: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
units.rightText: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life: no one cometh unto the Father, but by me.

units.leftText: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”
units.rightText: If ye had known me, ye would have known my Father also: from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

units.leftText: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
units.rightText: Philip saith unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

units.leftText: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
units.rightText: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and dost thou not know me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; how sayest thou, Show us the Father?

units.leftText: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
units.rightText: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I say unto you I speak not from myself: but the Father abiding in me doeth his works.

units.leftText: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
units.rightText: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

units.leftText: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
units.rightText: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto the Father.

units.leftText: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
units.rightText: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

units.leftText: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
units.rightText: If ye shall ask anything in my name, that will I do.

units.leftText: If you love me, keep my commandments.
units.rightText: If ye love me, ye will keep my commandments.

units.leftText: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
units.rightText: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may be with you for ever,
leftNotes: 14:16 Greek παρακλητον: Counselor, Helper, Intercessor, Advocate, and Comforter.

units.leftText: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
units.rightText: even the Spirit of truth: whom the world cannot receive; for it beholdeth him not, neither knoweth him: ye know him; for he abideth with you, and shall be in you.

units.leftText: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
units.rightText: I will not leave you desolate: I come unto you.

units.leftText: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
units.rightText: Yet a little while, and the world beholdeth me no more; but ye behold me: because I live, ye shall live also.

units.leftText: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
units.rightText: In that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

units.leftText: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
units.rightText: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself unto him.

units.leftText: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
units.rightText: Judas (not Iscariot) saith unto him, Lord, what is come to pass that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

units.leftText: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
units.rightText: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my word: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

units.leftText: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
units.rightText: He that loveth me not keepeth not my words: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

units.leftText: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.
units.rightText: These things have I spoken unto you, while yet abiding with you.

units.leftText: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
units.rightText: But the Comforter, even the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that I said unto you.

units.leftText: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
units.rightText: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

units.leftText: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
units.rightText: Ye heard how I said to you, I go away, and I come unto you. If ye loved me, ye would have rejoiced, because I go unto the Father: for the Father is greater than I.

units.leftText: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
units.rightText: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe.

units.leftText: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
units.rightText: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world cometh: and he hath nothing in me;

units.leftText: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.
units.rightText: but that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

units.leftText: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
units.rightText: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

units.leftText: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
units.rightText: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit, he taketh it away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he cleanseth it, that it may bear more fruit.

units.leftText: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
units.rightText: Already ye are clean because of the word which I have spoken unto you.

units.leftText: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
units.rightText: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; so neither can ye, except ye abide in me.

units.leftText: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
units.rightText: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit: for apart from me ye can do nothing.

units.leftText: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
units.rightText: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

units.leftText: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
units.rightText: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatsoever ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

units.leftText: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
units.rightText: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; and so shall ye be my disciples.

units.leftText: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
units.rightText: Even as the Father hath loved me, I also have loved you: abide ye in my love.

units.leftText: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
units.rightText: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.

units.leftText: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
units.rightText: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be made full.

units.leftText: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
units.rightText: This is my commandment, that ye love one another, even as I have loved you.

units.leftText: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
units.rightText: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

units.leftText: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
units.rightText: Ye are my friends, if ye do the things which I command you.

units.leftText: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
units.rightText: No longer do I call you servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I heard from my Father I have made known unto you.

units.leftText: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
units.rightText: Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

units.leftText: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
units.rightText: These things I command you, that ye may love one another.

units.leftText: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
units.rightText: If the world hateth you, ye know that it hath hated me before it hated you.

units.leftText: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
units.rightText: If ye were of the world, the world would love its own: but because ye are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

units.leftText: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
units.rightText: Remember the word that I said unto you, A servant is not greater than his lord. If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they kept my word, they will keep yours also.

units.leftText: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
units.rightText: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.

units.leftText: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
units.rightText: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no excuse for their sin.

units.leftText: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
units.rightText: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

units.leftText: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.
units.rightText: If I had not done among them the works which none other did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

units.leftText: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
units.rightText: But this cometh to pass, that the word may be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

units.leftText: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
units.rightText: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall bear witness of me:
leftNotes: 15:26 Greek Parakletos: Counselor, Helper, Advocate, Intercessor, and Comforter.

units.leftText: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
units.rightText: and ye also bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

units.leftText: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
units.rightText: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be caused to stumble.

units.leftText: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
units.rightText: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the hour cometh, that whosoever killeth you shall think that he offereth service unto God.

units.leftText: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.
units.rightText: And these things will they do, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

units.leftText: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
units.rightText: But these things have I spoken unto you, that when their hour is come, ye may remember them, how that I told you. And these things I said not unto you from the beginning, because I was with you.

units.leftText: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
units.rightText: But now I go unto him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

units.leftText: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
units.rightText: But because I have spoken these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

units.leftText: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
units.rightText: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is expedient for you that I go away; for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I go, I will send him unto you.

units.leftText: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
units.rightText: And he, when he is come, will convict the world in respect of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

units.leftText: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
units.rightText: of sin, because they believe not on me;

units.leftText: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
units.rightText: of righteousness, because I go to the Father, and ye behold me no more;

units.leftText: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
units.rightText: of judgment, because the prince of this world hath been judged.

units.leftText: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
units.rightText: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

units.leftText: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
units.rightText: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he shall guide you into all the truth: for he shall not speak from himself; but what things soever he shall hear, these shall he speak: and he shall declare unto you the things that are to come.

units.leftText: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.
units.rightText: He shall glorify me: for he shall take of mine, and shall declare it unto you.

units.leftText: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
units.rightText: All things whatsoever the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he taketh of mine, and shall declare it unto you.

units.leftText: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
units.rightText: A little while, and ye behold me no more; and again a little while, and ye shall see me.

units.leftText: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
units.rightText: Some of his disciples therefore said one to another, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye behold me not; and again a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

units.leftText: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
units.rightText: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? We know not what he saith.

units.leftText: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?
units.rightText: Jesus perceived that they were desirous to ask him, and he said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, A little while, and ye behold me not, and again a little while, and ye shall see me?

units.leftText: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
units.rightText: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

units.leftText: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
units.rightText: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but when she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for the joy that a man is born into the world.

units.leftText: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
units.rightText: And ye therefore now have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no one taketh away from you.

units.leftText: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
units.rightText: And in that day ye shall ask me no question. Verily, verily, I say unto you, If ye shall ask anything of the Father, he will give it you in my name.

units.leftText: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
units.rightText: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be made full.

units.leftText: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
units.rightText: These things have I spoken unto you in dark sayings: the hour cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in dark sayings, but shall tell you plainly of the Father.

units.leftText: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,
units.rightText: In that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you;

units.leftText: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
units.rightText: for the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came forth from the Father.

units.leftText: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”
units.rightText: I came out from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go unto the Father.

units.leftText: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.
units.rightText: His disciples say, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no dark saying.

units.leftText: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
units.rightText: Now know we that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

units.leftText: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
units.rightText: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

units.leftText: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
units.rightText: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

units.leftText: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
units.rightText: These things have I spoken unto you, that in me ye may have peace. In the world ye have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

units.leftText: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
units.rightText: These things spake Jesus; and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that the Son may glorify thee:

units.leftText: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
units.rightText: even as thou gavest him authority over all flesh, that to all whom thou hast given him, he should give eternal life.

units.leftText: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: And this is life eternal, that they should know thee the only true God, and him whom thou didst send, even Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
units.rightText: I glorified thee on the earth, having accomplished the work which thou hast given me to do.

units.leftText: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
units.rightText: And now, Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

units.leftText: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
units.rightText: I manifested thy name unto the men whom thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.

units.leftText: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
units.rightText: Now they know that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are from thee:

units.leftText: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.
units.rightText: for the words which thou gavest me I have given unto them; and they received them, and knew of a truth that I came forth from thee, and they believed that thou didst send me.

units.leftText: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
units.rightText: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for those whom thou hast given me; for they are thine:

units.leftText: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
units.rightText: and all things that are mine are thine, and thine are mine: and I am glorified in them.

units.leftText: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
units.rightText: And I am no more in the world, and these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep them in thy name which thou hast given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

units.leftText: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
units.rightText: While I was with them, I kept them in thy name which thou hast given me: and I guarded them, and not one of them perished, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

units.leftText: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.
units.rightText: Mary Magdalene cometh and telleth the disciples, I have seen the Lord; and that he had said these things unto her.

units.leftText: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
units.rightText: When therefore it was evening, on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were shut where the disciples were, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

units.leftText: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
units.rightText: And when he had said this, he showed unto them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad, when they saw the Lord.

units.leftText: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
units.rightText: Jesus therefore said to them again, Peace be unto you: as the Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

units.leftText: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!
units.rightText: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Spirit:

units.leftText: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”
units.rightText: whose soever sins ye forgive, they are forgiven unto them; whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

units.leftText: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
units.rightText: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

units.leftText: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!”
units.rightText: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.

units.leftText: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”
units.rightText: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them. Jesus cometh, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

units.leftText: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
units.rightText: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and see my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and put it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

units.leftText: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
units.rightText: Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

units.leftText: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
units.rightText: Jesus saith unto him, Because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

units.leftText: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
units.rightText: Many other signs therefore did Jesus in the presence of the disciples, which are not written in this book:

units.leftText: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
units.rightText: but these are written, that ye may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye may have life in his name.

units.leftText: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.
units.rightText: After these things Jesus manifested himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and he manifested himself on this wise.

units.leftText: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
units.rightText: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

units.leftText: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.”
units.rightText: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also come with thee. They went forth, and entered into the boat; and that night they took nothing.

units.leftText: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
units.rightText: But when day was now breaking, Jesus stood on the beach: yet the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

units.leftText: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?”
units.rightText: Jesus therefore saith unto them, Children, have ye aught to eat? They answered him, No.

units.leftText: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.”
units.rightText: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

units.leftText: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!”
units.rightText: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his coat about him (for he was naked), and cast himself into the sea.

units.leftText: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.
units.rightText: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits off), dragging the net full of fishes.
leftNotes: 21:8 200 cubits is about 100 yards or about 91 meters

units.leftText: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
units.rightText: So when they got out upon the land, they see a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

units.leftText: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
units.rightText: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now taken.

units.leftText: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
units.rightText: Simon Peter therefore went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fishes, a hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, the net was not rent.

units.leftText: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!”
units.rightText: Jesus saith unto them, Come and break your fast. And none of the disciples durst inquire of him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

units.leftText: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
units.rightText: Jesus cometh, and taketh the bread, and giveth them, and the fish likewise.

units.leftText: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
units.rightText: This is now the third time that Jesus was manifested to the disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

units.leftText: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?”
units.rightText: So when they had broken their fast, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of John, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

units.leftText: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?”
units.rightText: He saith to him again a second time, Simon, son of John, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Tend my sheep.

units.leftText: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?”
units.rightText: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of John, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

units.leftText: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
units.rightText: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

units.leftText: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
units.rightText: Now this he spake, signifying by what manner of death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

units.leftText: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
units.rightText: Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; who also leaned back on his breast at the supper, and said, Lord, who is he that betrayeth thee?

units.leftText: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
units.rightText: Peter therefore seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?

units.leftText: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
units.rightText: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

units.leftText: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
units.rightText: This saying therefore went forth among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, that he should not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
leftNotes: 21:23 The word for “brothers” here may be also correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

units.leftText: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
units.rightText: This is the disciple that beareth witness of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his witness is true.

units.leftText: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
units.rightText: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself would not contain the books that should be written.
